root_cause_analysis: Meta API request failed with OAuthException Code 4 (subcode 2207051): 'Application request limit reached' / 'Action is blocked'. The app or account has exceeded Meta's publishing velocity thresholds or triggered a temporary anti-spam action block.
actionable_instructions: Check Meta Developer Dashboard under 'API Rate Limit' or 'App Health' to inspect current usage and policy restrictions.
Log into the Instagram mobile app for the target account to verify if an 'Action Block' dialog needs manual acknowledgment.
Halt automated queue processing for 24 hours to allow the application limit window to reset.
